hypothesis: India grid-access intelligence: ISTS connectivity / GNA headroom, time-to-effective prediction and change alerts for RE & BESS developers (where can I connect, when, at what cost)
initial_customer: Tier-2 RE/BESS developers on the CTUIL 11/SM/2026 stranded list (Datta Power Infra, Prerak Greentech, Sprng, Hexa Climate, Juniper Green, Oriana, Pace Digitek, Refex, GRT Jewellers) plus regulatory advisors (Mercados, Idam) and law firms as a channel
economic_buyer: Head of BD/origination or head of regulatory affairs at a Tier-2 IPP (discretionary budget below ~Rs 5 lakh); at listed firms a 4-8 week PO cycle; PSU-owned developers buy via GeM/e-tender
painful_workflow_or_decision: Choosing substation/MW/technology at bid time; tracking CTUIL bay-margin sheets, cluster declarations, reallocation windows, deficiency letters and 15-day deadlines; deciding among merchant/re-tender/surrender options; financial-closure timing tied to firm connectivity dates
existing_alternative: CTUIL's own filterable 636-row effective-connectivity table with XLS export and API-backed status page; in-house regulatory teams (Cleanmax, Gentari, Mahindra Susten, Serentica, ACME file their own CERC comments); law firms (JSA, K&S) after revocation; consultants (Idam, Mercados); analysts reading PDFs
proposed_product: Parse every CTUIL/CERC/RLDC publication (bay/substation margins by solar/non-solar hour, grant lists, effective status, clusters, reallocation notices, SCOD extensions) into a geocoded versioned substation database; predict time-to-effective and reallocation options; alert on changes; optional satellite stage-verified field

output: Ranked substation shortlist with expected time-to-effective and risk; alerts on CTUIL/CERC changes affecting the customer's applications; 11/SM/2026 option analysis
why_useful: Connectivity failure has hard rupee costs: BG encashments Rs 3.1-11.5 Cr per developer (Prerak, Datta, Sprng), Rs 19.26 Cr compensation deposits (ReNew/Serentica), compensation at Rs 1,612/MW/day, proposed milestone charges Rs 1,500-6,000/MW/day; ~22 GW stranded; one avoided late-FC event dwarfs a Rs 2-10 lakh/yr fee
how_value_verified: Experiment F1-A: backtest predicted vs actual effective dates on 2023-2026 grant lists (AUC >=0.70 for effective-within-12-months = skill); Experiment F1-A0: written CTUIL permission to reuse data; Experiment B: 10 interviews (>=4 pay today or lost >=Rs 1 Cr; >=3 accept Rs 1-3 lakh pilot)
prototype_time_cost: 4-7 days for parser + database + first model at ~Rs 0 (founder time); 4-6 weeks to a sellable alerting layer
first_customer_path: Outbound to the ~70 entities on CTUIL's 17 Sep 2026 eligible list during their 60-day election window; Bengaluru-local Pace Digitek and Ayana; sell as a diligence feed through Mercados/Idam/JSA/NSEFI

main_competitors: CTUIL itself (table, status API, archive, NSWS); CES; law firms JSA/K&S; consultants Idam/Mercados; Mercom/JMK/Tenderkosh re-publish lists; US analogues Nira Energy and Pearl Street/Enverus have no India presence

initial_customer: Multi-site manufacturers and large loads on Karnataka W&B/GEOA agreements listed by KPTCL SLDC: Shahi Exports (>=6 HT installations), Biocon, Sansera, Himatsingka, Narayana Hrudayalaya, Bagmane, RMZ, Infosys (40 MW), Wipro, Toyota Tsusho, BIAL; TN textile mills and MH group-captive offtakers later

hypothesis: CBAM embedded-emissions engine: Specific Embedded Emissions per CN code, Monitoring Methodology Document and verifier-ready data packs for Indian steel, aluminium and cement exporters

economic_buyer: Head of O&M / asset management at an IPP; O&M budgets already fund annual or post-monsoon drone thermography
painful_workflow_or_decision: Finding hotspots, PID, diode failures, soiling, string outages; scheduling annual/post-monsoon inspections; proving incremental value over the plant's own SCADA string-level alarms
existing_alternative: Plant SCADA/APM (Prescinto now IBM Maximo; SenseHawk via Reliance/Nextracker; Raptor Maps; Sitemark; SmartHelio); drone thermography services (SenseHawk scanned Adani's 780 MW Kamuthi twice in 18 months; Elion IEC 62446-3 flights); in-house teams

output: Portfolio exception list and inspection prioritisation; soiling/flood/vegetation flags

first_customer_path: Mid-size IPP without a global APM contract; drone service providers as channel
pricing_model: MW-based SaaS (Raptor Maps model) - India prices quote-based; US thermal flights US$400-600/hour
main_competitors: IBM/Prescinto, Reliance-Nextracker/SenseHawk, Raptor Maps, Sitemark, SmartHelio, Clir; Indian drone operators; OEM monitoring portals
primary_risks: Consolidated by IBM/Reliance/Nextracker; the valuable signal is drone-only; Prescinto (Bengaluru) lost ~3x revenue before selling; prices opaque; satellites add only portfolio-level screening; buyer's market
defensibility_vs_frontier_models: Analytics on others' drone/SCADA data is contested and reproducible; no proprietary data without customer telemetry rights
expansion_path: None toward F1-F3; possibly a feature for F3 compliance (availability tracking)
uncertainty_notes: Not red-teamed; raw 48 with ~10-point expected haircut. No Indian Rs/MW drone thermography price found; SenseHawk 2022 Reliance deal and 2024 Nextracker sale not reconciled; soiling and flood-loss quantification for India not found
key_evidence_for: SenseHawk thermography of 2.5 million modules at Adani Kamuthi in under three weeks, second scan in 18 months; Elion recommends annual minimum and post-monsoon inspections; Raptor Maps 100+ GW analysed; MW-based SaaS is the accepted pricing unit
key_evidence_against: Prescinto acquired by IBM (FY23 revenue Rs 8.15 Cr, loss Rs 25.9 Cr); SenseHawk majority bought by Reliance (US$32M) then reported to Nextracker; module-level thermography is drone-only; SCADA already flags string losses; prices quote-based
score_change_rationale: No change: not red-teamed; shown raw at 48 with expected haircut ~38
